decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-672c6336b39c] names the subject exactly: eight Helm values (hubble.tls.server.cert/key, hubble.relay.tls.client.cert/key, hubble.relay.tls.server.cert/key, hubble.ui.tls.client.cert/key). It also states the change: they are deprecated in favour of the associated `existingSecret` options. The proposals called this a bundle of several changes, but it is one uniform change (the same deprecation and the same kind of replacement) applied to a listed set of keys. That makes the exposure definable: environments that set any of these values. The consequence is a deprecation-class warning: the values are only scheduled for removal "in a future release", and the text claims nothing breaks in 1.17. One gap: the exact names of the replacement `existingSecret` keys are not spelled out.
